After years of delays, the Mobile River Bridge and Bayway project is finally moving toward construction. This is a major win for Mobile, Baldwin County, the Gulf Coast, and the entire Southeast.

Thanks to President Trump’s leadership, Alabama is one step closer to delivering this transformational infrastructure project.
posts.summary: Credits Trump for advancing major infrastructure project

posts.text:
What an honor to be on Fort Rucker and back in the Wiregrass for today’s ribbon cutting of the new Advanced Individual Training barracks.

I’m thrilled the $41.2 million I secured in FY24 appropriations helped complete this state-of-the-art facility for the next generation of Army Aviation solders.

This is an important investment in our soldiers, Fort Rucker’s mission, Army Aviation, and our nation’s warfighter. Proud to be a part of it.
